facts.text: John participated in a marching event for veterans' rights.

evidence.quote: I just participated in a marching event for veterans' rights and it was awesome, made me remember how much they sacrifice for us.

facts.text: John expressed that being around others who shared the same values and passion motivated him.

evidence.quote: It reminded me how important it is to try and make a difference through activism. It really motivated me.

facts.text: Maria acknowledged John's participation in the marching event for veterans' rights.

evidence.quote: That's awesome, John! Surrounding yourself with determined people striving for the same goals can be really motivating.

facts.text: John stated that he wanted to show support for the military and believed in standing up for what he believed in.

evidence.quote: I've always had a great respect for our military and wanted to show my support. I think it's important to stand up for what we believe in.
